I really like this app because it’s free and pretty simple. Other voice changer apps cost something like 10 dollars a month or something like that. Other voice changer apps are also really complicated but for this app you just say what you want to turn into voice and then watch an add and then you can turn the voice recording into whichever voice you want it to be. There is a couple problems though, first of all the adds, you have to watch an add after every voice recording you make which I think is reasonable but it’s also really annoying. I am happy with the fact you can remove adds though. Second of all there isn’t many things you can change your voice to. Some people think it’s enough, Some people don’t care and some people are annoyed there isn’t a lot of things you can change your voice to. I don’t necessarily care about it but it you sometimes get bored of it. Those are the only problems about the game that I know of. I do highly recommend this game for people who just want a voice changer and don’t want to pay.

The pros: First up, you don’t have to pay. In all the other apps I’ve seen, there has always been some sort of problem with this or that. You have to pay, or, there’s too many ads! But this game has none of that. There’s no problems with this app, and it has some cool voices that are good for pranks. The cons: The only thing I don’t love about this game is that there are only a few voices, and a lot of them are sort of the same thing. For example, the big robot and the small robot??? I mean, c’mon, seriously?! Yeah, big difference, folks. And the chipmunk, bee, and child? Naw man. These are all the same voices. There is not a whole lot to do on this app, and you can get tired of it quickly. It gets really boring, and it’s not something you can do with your friends, like you can in among us, Roblox, Minecraft, etc. So if your somebody like me, then I don’t really recommend this game for those who get bored of doing the same thing everyday. But if you aren’t one of those people, I totally think you should get this game.

I like this app. It’s super good considering that it’s free. You only have to pay $1.99 to get rid of the ads. The ads aren’t really that much. There’s only one after you finish recording your voice. And it would be really great if there was an older kid voice or a teen voice.  PLEASE take those things into consideration. Nice app. 👍
